name: 11418 · Richmond Hill, NY
findings: ZIP 11418 (Richmond Hill) has 115 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11418 (Richmond Hill) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
93% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11418 (Richmond Hill) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 96% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
